trust_decision.summary: Whether an ffmpeg command string received by the standalone FFmpeg endpoint is safe to pass to the execAsync 'sh -c' sink; decided only by a character-strip denylist plus prefix allowlist in sanitizeFFmpegCommand.

landing_point.why: The summary names sanitizeFFmpegCommand and the single '&'; the denylist regex is the obvious one-character edit.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP/CLI plugin/API/standAlone/ffmpeg.json.php (codeToExecEncrypted -> ffmpegCommand), fed by execFFMPEGAsyncOrRemote remote branch (objects/functionsFFMPEG.php:935-939)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The local execFFMPEGAsyncOrRemote fallback runs server-built commands, never goes through the standalone API, and its URL pieces already pass clearCommandURL, so it looks like a separate, already sanitized feature.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The sink wrapper and the endpoint add their own shell operators after sanitizing ('&' backgrounding in execAsync, '&& php ... notify' and '2>&1'), and restream URLs may legitimately carry '&' in query strings. A fix inside execAsync that escapes '&' or the whole string breaks backgrounding and PID capture, and stripping '&' everywhere breaks restream URLs with query strings.

O6_input_shapes: single '&' (background/separator) in ffmpegCommand string; '&&' was already removed at plugin/API/standAlone/functions.php:97 and '&>' redirects at :101

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Local branch of execFFMPEGAsyncOrRemote passes the command straight to execAsync (same sh -c sink) without calling sanitizeFFmpegCommand; restream destination URLs reach it after clearCommandURL, which explicitly keeps '&'.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the in-process path (no standalone server configured), with server-built commands, and its URLs already go through clearCommandURL, so the 'standalone sanitizer' advisory looks like it does not apply.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package: objects/functionsFFMPEG.php and plugin/Live/standAloneFiles/restreamer.json.php:572,784,796,822 versus plugin/API/standAlone/functions.php

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a local-branch call to a shared ffmpeg-command sanitizer that keeps the old denylist without '&'
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The maintainer already sends both branches through one dispatcher; a local-mode sanitizer copied from the standalone one would be a natural hardening step that drifted out of sync.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a URL cleaner whose allowlist keeps '&' for query strings and whose output is concatenated into the restream command
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already exists in this form: '&' is kept for rtmp/http query strings, which is a legitimate need.

O9_family: OS command injection via incomplete shell-metacharacter denylist (CWE-78)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8 + composer (vendor/ is committed), phpunit per phpunit.xml
services: MySQL/MariaDB for the full app; sanitizeFFmpegCommand and clearCommandURL are pure functions callable in isolation
ffmpeg binary only for end-to-end runs
O10_build.project_tests: phpunit.xml defines tests/Security and tests/Unit suites; no test there mentions sanitizeFFmpegCommand, clearCommandURL or execAsync (grep found nothing)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add '&' to the regex character class at plugin/API/standAlone/functions.php:104 and stop.

out_of_scope_notes: listFFmpegProcesses puts the raw decrypted keyword inside a quoted grep in exec() (plugin/API/standAlone/functions.php:143, called from plugin/API/standAlone/ffmpeg.json.php:221 and :341); different sink (exec), not pursued.
Restreamer non-execFFMPEGAsyncOrRemote fallback calls exec() directly with the restream command (plugin/Live/standAloneFiles/restreamer.json.php:826); different sink, not pursued.
execAsync escapes only '"' (objects/functionsExec.php:686) and the denylist does not strip backslash; whether a backslash breaks out of the outer double quotes was not analysed.
This is a follow-up to CVE-2026-33482, with 7 sibling advisories on the same endpoint family; a denylist approach invites more bypass follow-ups.
unverified: Whether a low-privileged user can set restream destination URLs containing '&' that reach the local execAsync branch (restreamer.json.php access control and the _getLiveKey destination source were not traced).
Whether the standalone server mode is the default; the local branch runs only when API standAloneFFMPEG is empty (objects/functionsFFMPEG.php:912).
